name: Stickman MCP

motions.label: Walk Start
motions.summary: Simple relaxed start from idle stand into the approved walk cycle: one tiny weight shift, then a single normal first step that lands on walk phase 0.
motions.semanticFallback: Walk Start: Simple relaxed start from idle stand into the approved walk cycle: one tiny weight shift, then a single normal first step that lands on walk phase 0.

motions.label: Walk Stop
motions.summary: A walking contact pose eases into a short final step, the trailing foot gathers alongside, and the body lightly brakes before settling into neutral stand.
motions.semanticFallback: Walk Stop: A walking contact pose eases into a short final step, the trailing foot gathers alongside, and the body lightly brakes before settling into neutral stand.

motions.label: Walk On
motions.summary: Walks from fully off-stage left to center with three world-locked strides, then takes two settling steps.

motions.label: Walk Off

motions.label: Enter Door
motions.summary: Emerges through a visibly open left-side doorway, walks naturally onto the presentation stage, and settles into neutral.
